answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1721 impostors cost 1243 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
